links.outcome: Accuracy of six LLMs on 100 bladder cancer guideline questions, compared across models
links.effect: Claude-3.5-Sonnet 89.33% ± 1.53%, ChatGPT-4 85.67%, Grok-beta 84.33%, Gemini-1.5-Pro 82.00%, Mistral-Large-2 81.00%, GPT-3.5-Turbo 74.33% ± 3.06%; accuracy varied across candidate models.
links.quote: In the initial evaluation, Claude-3.5-Sonnet demonstrated the highest accuracy (89.33% ± 1.53%), followed by ChatGPT-4 (85.67% ± 1.15%).

unlisted_practices: Two-phase targeted training optimization of an LLM on domain-specific guideline questions to improve accuracy

screen.reason: The study evaluates six LLMs on a 100-question benchmark regarding bladder cancer management and tests fine-tuning/optimization on GPT-3.5-Turbo, but does not evaluate an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
